mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an innate or inborn ability to resist certain types of diseases and this immunity does not involve production of antibodies."
Natural immunity is an innate or inborn ability to resist certain types of diseases and this immunity does not involve production of antibodies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to complete removal of a disease from an area."
Eradication refers to complete removal of a disease from an area.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a disease causing microorganism such as a bacteria, virus etc."
An infectious agent is a disease causing microorganism such as a bacteria, virus etc.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the number of animals that develop a disease at a specific time and this indicates how serious and how long the disease affects the population of animals."
Prevalence of a disease refers to the number of animals that develop a disease at a specific time and this indicates how serious and how long the disease affects the population of animals.
fib: ______ is a disease causing microbial agent.
A pathogen is a disease causing microbial agent.
______ is a biological substance which stimulates the body's immune system to produce antibodies.
A vaccine is a biological substance which stimulates the body's immune system to produce antibodies.
______ means avoidance of disease and control refers to reduction in disease incidence or prevalence.
Prevention in this sense simply means avoidance of disease and control refers to reduction in disease incidence or prevalence.
______ is the second most important cause of production loses in Nigerian livestock industry and poor animal health remains a constraint to livestock productivity.
Disease is the second most important cause of production loses in Nigerian livestock industry and poor animal health remains a constraint to livestock productivity.
